info.name: Smart Microgrid - Component 4 Platform Administration API
info.description:
Backoffice REST API for Component 4 (Platform Administration & System Operations).

Run 'Login as Administrator' first: it captures the JWT into {{authToken}} for every other request.

All /api/admin/* routes are Admin-only. A non-admin receives 403 and an anonymous caller receives 401, so the RBAC folder is safe to run as a negative check.

Suggested order: Authentication -> Administrative Dashboard -> System Configuration -> System Activity -> Reports -> User Account Lifecycle -> Access Control Checks.

The account lifecycle requests are chained: each one depends on {{targetUserId}}, captured by 'List Users'. 'Restore Account To Active' is intentionally last so the target is not left Pending.

item.name: Last Active Admin Cannot Be Suspended (Expected Failure)

request.description:
The platform refuses to stand down its final backoffice officer.

PREREQUISITE: this request only fails as described when exactly one active administrator remains. While a second administrator is still active the same request succeeds, which is the intended redundancy behaviour.

To exercise it: (1) run 'List Active Administrators', (2) stand every administrator down except one via Suspend Account, (3) put the survivor's id in {{lastAdminId}}, (4) run this request. {{lastAdminId}} ships empty on purpose so a full collection run cannot silently disable a real administrator account.

exec: pm.test('Guard message returned', function () { pm.expect((j.message || j.error || '').toLowerCase()).to.contain('last active'); });

item.name: Demote An Administrator Is Refused When Last (Expected Failure)

request.description: Only Admin can reassign roles, so demoting the final Admin would leave nobody able to promote anyone back. The platform refuses, exactly as it does for standing the last Admin down. {{lastAdminId}} ships empty so a full run cannot trigger this against a real account; see the 'Last Active Admin Cannot Be Suspended' notes for the prerequisite.

exec: pm.test('Guard message returned', function () { pm.expect((j.message || j.error || '').toLowerCase()).to.contain('last active backoffice officer'); });
